  WHY: The SUCCEEDED line can claim e2e passed when it was skipped. The reviewer rated it NIT with low likelihood.

On a skip_e2e=true dispatch all five are skipped (lines 5400, 5601, 5853, 5931, 6151-6153). The new E2E_ICON check (lines 7663-7670) handles only the e2e slot, while LOG_ANALYSIS_ICON (lines 7649-7654) is already dynamic.
  WHY: A successful skip_e2e=true run reports five live tests as passed when they were skipped. The all_supplemental_ok loop (line 7640) already accepts skipped, so the SUCCEEDED path is reachable.

  WHY: The SUCCEEDED line can claim e2e passed when it was skipped. This is lower likelihood than the first finding.
